name: KHB
recent: 近期公告主要涉及独立非执行董事 Ang Yoke Kee 的股权变动，包括在闭门期内的交易及交易意向。公司没有发布合约、业务或财报相关公告。
notable: 独立非执行董事 Ang Yoke Kee 于 2026 年 10 月 19 日在闭门期外增持 37,800 股普通股。
Ang Yoke Kee 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日及 6 日在闭门期内分别增持 3,000 股及 97,000 股普通股。
risks: 董事在闭门期内进行股份交易，相关交易已按上市条例第 14 章申报。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly relate to changes in the shareholding of Independent Non-Executive Director Ang Yoke Kee, including dealings during the closed period and intention to deal. There were no announcements on contracts, business or financial results.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ang Yoke Kee acquired 37,800 ordinary shares outside the closed period on 19 Oct 2026.
Ang Yoke Kee acquired 3,000 and 97,000 ordinary shares during the closed period on 5 and 6 Nov 2026 respectively.
risks_en: The director traded shares during the closed period, and the dealings were announced under Chapter 14 of the listing requirements.
